assertions.assertion: The claim was for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring
The denial was issued under reason code CO-197
CO-197 indicates that required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date

The clinical indication note states the patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, occurring in the context of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The diagnosis codes on the claim are R55, G45.9, and I48.0
The clinical indication is consistent with diagnosis codes R55, G45.9, and I48.0
The note states mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate and rhythm control strategies
Reconsideration of the CO-197 denial is being requested
